comparison.objective: Pour an accurate 10 mL syrup dose while holding a cup level, then place both vessels; candidate adjusts a mechanical stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated vessel holding, flow-rate control, and precise pour termination; no threaded adjustment or locking reaction.
comparison.success_condition: Scores dose volume, spill, observability, placement, and settling; candidate scores locked opening angle and repeatable cycles.
comparison.reason: Precision pouring and spill control are unrelated to two-tool setting preservation despite both requiring bimanual coordination.
